variant_title_en: Multiplication and Division of Whole Numbers
title_en: Multiplication and Division of Whole Numbers
story_theme_en: Mali plants roses in her garden in rows. She plants 24 rows with 125 rose plants in each row. How many rose plants are there in total? If she gives away 600 roses to her friends, how many roses will she have left?
helper_tip: Multiplication is repeated addition. Division is equal sharing.
hint_th: การคูณคือการบวกซ้ำๆ ส่วนการหารคือการแบ่งเท่าๆ กัน

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Multiplication: 24 rows x 125 plants/row = total roses | Subtraction: total - 600 = roses left

visual_blocks.title: Try It
visual_blocks.question: A factory packs water bottles. It produces 35 rows with 48 bottles per row. How many bottles in total? If it sells 800 bottles, how many are left?

data.question: A factory packs water bottles. It produces 35 rows with 48 bottles per row. How many bottles in total? If it sells 800 bottles, how many are left?

worked_examples.question_en: A shop sells oranges. 15 rows with 48 oranges per row. How many oranges in total?

common_mistakes: Forgetting to carry when the product exceeds 9
hints: Use long multiplication: multiply each digit from right to left.
